messages:
alice: kicking off v2 rollout to eu-west now, starting at 10% traffic. hope to ramp to 50% if no regressions.
deploy-bot: canary start: v2 -> eu-west; target=10%; run_id=r-20260301-245; started by alice
ben: saw 1.5x tail latency in staging loadtest earlier, might be related to batching heuristic. tagging caroline.
caroline: noted. I pushed a batching toggle that should reduce p99. it's off by default in v2, but some clients may trigger larger batches due to header grouping.
dan_sre: will watch infra. setting alert for 500s and grpc timeouts. also preparing quick rollback playbook.
eva: FYI client-sdk 2.1 changes header name from `x-rdwd-client` -> `x-rdwd-client-v2`. older clients will fallback but we should verify server doesn't treat missing header as error.
alice: good catch. does v2 reject requests missing the header?
caroline: no, it should not reject. but there is a strict validation path in the auth middleware that logs + 400 if payload has unexpected shape. I added a guard but might be flaky.
ben: smoke tests just showed a small number of 400s for older sdk calls. not widespread but visible in errors-per-minute.
deploy-bot: metric alert fired: api.v2.requests.400 increased by 0.7% in eu-west at 2026-03-01T15:12:03Z
alice: decision point: continue ramp or pause and pin v1 for eu-west?
dan_sre: recommend pause at 20% until we confirm validation path. rolling back quickly is painful if clients are split.
eva: ops-wise we can pin route for customers on older SDKs using route-map: `route: /v1/* -> model: v1` for specific org_ids. that buys time.
caroline: I can push a hotfix to relax validation within 15-20 minutes. but we should avoid full rollback if possible.
ben: can we patch auth middleware without redeploying runtime? maybe feature flag flip?
caroline: there is a config flag `strict_payload_validation=false` that applies on reload. I can flip via config service; no full deploy.
dan_sre: great. then pause ramp, flip flag, wait 5m, re-run small smoke.
alice: agreed. pausing ramp now. deploy-bot: please pause canary.
deploy-bot: canary pause acknowledged: run_id=r-20260301-245; traffic=10% -> paused
ben: after flag flip we'll re-run smoke: curl -H "x-rdwd-client: legacy" https://api.eu-west.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
alice: caroline, proceed with config flip when ready. keep me posted in-thread.
caroline: flipping `strict_payload_validation` to false via config service now.
deploy-bot: config change applied: strict_payload_validation=false (id cfg-7782)
caroline: smoke after flip: 3/3 success from legacy sdk. no 400s in the logs.
ben: monitoring shows 400s dropped to baseline. latency stable.
dan_sre: thumbs up from infra. no elevated 5xx.
eva: I'll notify support + post release note blurb about header change and recommended SDK update.
alice: ok resume ramp to 25% and hold for 10m. if stable we'll continue. deploy-bot: resume to 25%.
deploy-bot: canary update: run_id=r-20260301-245; traffic=25%
caroline: also adding a short-term compatibility test in our CI that runs legacy sdk against v2 endpoints every hour.
ben: suggest we pin a small set of high-risk orgs to v1 for 24h as extra safety. eva can coordinate list.
eva: will compile list and apply route-map pins for the next 24h. will post changes to #release-ops.
alice: final note: add a line in release notes: "v2 strict payload validation relaxed due to compatibility; will reintroduce with opt-in after SDK migration". tagging release manager for change window.
deploy-bot: canary run r-20260301-245 status: progressing; traffic=25%; no new alerts in last 10m
caroline: thanks team. keeping thread open for 1hr, will escalate if anything spikes.
ben: +1
dan_sre: 👍
eva: :white_check_mark:
